verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document per-institution status, outage or degradation signals, or error codes that separate bank-side failures from client-side ones. Institution feature flags (e.g. INITIATE_EMBEDDED_ACCOUNT_REQUEST) describe what an institution supports, not its health. Payment-status webhooks track individual transactions, not institution health, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
